title: Unify SDK auth/retries/streaming ergonomics  parity fixes + v1.197.1 version bump
author: Jordan Lee
release_notes: - SDK: unify auth APIs across Python/TypeScript/Go for consistent token refresh and retry behavior. - Streaming: stabilize client-side stream re-attach and backpressure ergonomics. - Parity: fix behavior mismatch in Go client for call signatures and TS/py ergonomics. - Version bump to v1.197.1 across SDKs. - No breaking changes for existing callers; minor ergonomics improvements and bug fixes.
description:
Context: This PR consolidates several cross-language SDK changes required to bring auth/retries and streaming ergonomics into parity across Python, TypeScript, and Go. Motivation is to reduce surprising differences between SDKs (token refresh hooks, default retry backoff, streaming reconnection) and to prepare a small patch release (v1.197.1) that fixes customer-observed mismatches.
What changed:
1) Auth: Introduce a shared config pattern across SDKs (AuthProvider interface / abstract class) that standardizes token refresh callbacks and error mapping.
2) Retries: Align default retry policy (idempotent vs non-idempotent) and expose per-client overrides; fix an off-by-one in backoff calculation found in the Go SDK.
3) Streaming: Improve client-side reattach logic to support transient network drops and provide clearer hooks for consumer backpressure in TS/py.
4) Ergonomics: Simplify constructor signatures and deprecate legacy params with clear migration notes.
5) Parity fixes: Small API shape changes to match TS and Python with Go (method names, option keys).
6) Version bumps: Update package.json/go.mod/setup.cfg to v1.197.1 and update changelogs.
Checklist:
- [x] Implement cross-SDK auth abstraction and migrate per-language implementations
- [x] Update retry policy and add tests for edge cases
- [x] Streaming reconnection tests and documentation examples
- [x] Bump versions and update release notes
- [x] Add migration notes in docs
Related: Linear ENG-1971 tracks the cross-SDK parity work. Also references earlier PRs that started the unification (see linked PRs).
Risk: Low/medium; changes are mostly additive but touching auth/retry semantics warrants careful testing. We ran unit and integration tests across all SDKs and performed a dogfood run on a handful of internal services.
Merge notes: squash merge; coordinated release across package registries.

diff_snippets: python: standardized AuthProvider ABC and token refresh hook; ts: added reattach() helper on StreamingClient; go: fixed backoff calc (was using n instead of n-1) and exported RetryPolicy struct. Small ci config tweaks to run cross-language integration harness.
review_conversation: Priya Shah: Left a comment about race condition when refreshing tokens during streaming reconnect. Suggested using a per-connection mutex for Go and explicit async refresh hook in JS/Python.
Jordan Lee (author): Addressed by adding a per-connection token lock in Go and documenting the async refresh contract in TS/Python; pushed fix in commit 3.
Miguel Torres: Requested a test for transient 502 -> 200 reconnect scenario for streaming; noted the TS implementation looked good but asked for an extra assertion around buffer draining.
Jordan Lee: Added test test_stream_reconnect and expanded assertions; updated docs with example backpressure handling.
Samira Patel: Approved after verifying CI and local dogfood run; no further changes requested.
notes: Coordinated release: maintainers will publish new packages to PyPI, npm, and Go proxy within the release window. Operations notified to watch SDK telemetry for auth/retry regressions for 48 hours post-release.
